summary: Iteration 9 (retention dropdown + history-on-mount + wipe + sweeper) verified end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 new tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_retention.py — including the primary bug fix (3 messages persist for an offline reader and are returned by GET /api/rooms/{id}/messages on reconnect), POST /rooms/create accepting retention_mode with 10min default + invalid->10min fallback, PATCH /rooms/{id}/settings owner-only (403 for non-owner, 400 on invalid mode), POST /rooms/{id}/wipe by any member (404 for non-member), mark-message-read schedules delete_at for 5/10/15min within ±30s but does NOT set delete_at for on_refresh, and the background _retention_sweeper deletes past-due messages within ~30s. Regression: all 16 prior tests in test_iteration7_features.py + test_iteration8_features.py still pass. Frontend (mobile viewport): /room/{id} shows testID='settings-btn' only for owner, the modal exposes all four retention-5min/10min/15min/on_refresh radios, selecting on_refresh broadcasts settings_updated and makes testID='wipe-btn' appear immediately, a pre-seeded on_refresh room shows wipe-btn from the start, and /room/create review step (step 4 of 4) exposes the same four retention testIDs plus testID='create-room-submit'. The WS handler in app/room/[id].tsx correctly handles 'wiped', 'scheduled_delete', 'settings_updated' and 'deleted' (re-enabled) events; load() now fetches /rooms/{id}/messages on mount; the WS effect only depends on id and runs a 25s JSON ping. Deprecated package warning persists (expo-av).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated package still imported (warning fires on every screen load). Migrate to expo-audio + expo-video before SDK 54. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:15

critical_code_review_comments: load() in /app/frontend/app/room/[id].tsx fetches /rooms/{id}/messages on mount (line 140) — primary bug fix verified.
WS effect depends only on `id` and reads the auth user lazily via userRef (lines 153-161) — no more open/close churn.
25s keepalive ping is wired correctly (lines 255-261) and cleared on cleanup.
Server-side _retention_sweeper runs every 30s, deletes by message_id+room_id, broadcasts 'deleted' (server.py:2284-2309). Schedule is idempotent (cond `and not msg.get('delete_at')`).
POST /api/rooms/{id}/wipe correctly requires membership (404 for non-members) and broadcasts {type:'wiped',by_user_id,by_name}.
PATCH /api/rooms/{id}/settings enforces owner-only (403 for non-owner) and rejects invalid modes (400).
Frontend WS handler covers all four iter-9 event types: wiped, scheduled_delete, settings_updated, deleted.

rca_of_issue: The 'messages sent but not received' bug had two causes — (1) chat screen reset messages to [] on mount without ever fetching the persisted history, so an offline reader returning to the room saw an empty pane; (2) the WS effect depended on user?.user_id and reconnected on every auth-context re-render, which the backend logged as open/close churn. Fix in /app/frontend/app/room/[id].tsx: load() now does both GET /rooms/{id} and GET /rooms/{id}/messages on mount (line 140), the WS useEffect depends only on `id` and reads `user` lazily via userRef (lines 153-161), and a 25s JSON ping keeps the ingress proxy from reaping the socket (lines 255-261). Both backend pytest (test_history_returned_for_late_reader) and the frontend room screen behavior confirm the fix.
